articles.summary: Zions Bancorporation, N.A. (NASDAQ: ZION) announced today that its board of directors has authorized share repurchases of up to $72 million of the company's common stock for the fourth quarter of 2026 as part of the company's previously authorized share repurchase target for 2026 of $300 million. The timing and amounts of any such actions will depend on market conditions, regulatory requirements, and other factors or uncertainties and may be updated at the discretion of the board. The board also declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.48 per common share, payable November 19, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on November 12, 2026. Additionally, the board declared the regular quarterly cash dividend on the company's Series A perpetual preferred shares (NASDAQ: ZIONP; CUSIP: 98973A104). articles.summary: MacDonald to oversee Commercial, Corporate and Specialty Industry banking divisions while continuing leadership of Zions Capital Markets SAN DIEGO, CA — October 26, 2026 — California Bank Trust (CBT), a division of Zions Bancorporation, N.A., and a leading financial institution serving businesses and individuals across the state, today announced the appointment of Michael MacDonald as President. Reporting to CEO Eric Ellingsen, MacDonald will oversee CBT’s Commercial, Corporate and Specialty Industry banking businesses, while working closely with the leadership team on the bank’s broader strategic execution and market expansion across California. A seasoned financial executive with extensive leadership experience, MacDonald will also continue to lead Zions Capital Markets and serve on the Executive Management Committee of Zions Bancorporation.
